title: Khoon e haider
body:
Khoon e haider
Haye ali, haye haye ali..(2)
Behta hai khoon e haider, koofe mein karbala mein
Zehra ka ghar luta hai, haaye rahe khuda mein
<<MINI>>
koofe mein karbala mein
behta hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Ek fajr par hai sajda, ek sajda asr par hai
ek simt par hai beta, ek simt pe padar hai
kya fark hai batao, dono pe is jafa mein
<<MINI>>
koofe mein karbala mein
behta hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Koofe mein murtaza ki, beti pe hai yatimi
shabbir ki yatima, karbobala mein ujdi
hai zainab o sakina, ek dard ki fiza mein
<<MINI>>
koofe mein karbala mein
behta hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Kulsoom aur zainab, padhti rahi hai nauha
baba ko zakhmi dekha, bhai ko zakhmi dekha
manzar hai ek jaisa, is dehr e bewafa mein
<<MINI>>
koofe mein karbala mein
behta hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Maloom tha ali ko, sajda na hoga pura
sarwar ko bhi pata hai, ab aakhri hai sajda
sar ko jhukaya phir bhi, taazeem e kibriya mein
<<MINI>>
koofe mein karbala mein
behta hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Haye, qasim ke ho wo tukde, ya ho gulu e asghar
akbar ka ho wo seena, ya baazu e dilawar
imraa'n ka khoo'n baha hai, haye bughze murtaza mein
<<MINI>>
koofe mein karbala mein
behta hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Salmaan aur meesum, tareekh hai batati
guzri hai zindagi bas, aulad e sayyeda ki
matam mein murtaza ke, shabbir ki azaa mein
<<MINI>>
koofe mein karbala mein
behta hai...
koofe mein karbala mein..(2)
